Dispatch software for carriers who run on thin margins

Acme Freight replaces the whiteboard and the spreadsheet. We plan routes, assign drivers and reconcile fuel spend for regional carriers running between fifty and eight hundred trucks.

Our customers are dispatchers, not engineers. Every feature we ship has to survive a truck stop parking lot on a bad cellular connection.

What we run on

A Postgres core, an event log for telemetry ingest, and a React operations console. We deploy several times a day and keep the on-call rotation small on purpose.
